Package com.egradx.notification.spi

Interface EgradxSmsProvider

All Known Implementing Classes:
EgradxTwilioSmsProvider
public interface EgradxSmsProvider
An SMS gateway. The SMS channel picks one per organization by the provider setting of its stored configuration, so switching gateways is a settings change.

Twilio is built in ("twilio"). Another gateway — MSG91, Vonage, AWS SNS, a local aggregator — is one bean implementing this; an organization then selects it by its name(). The provider does only the HTTP call: address checks, content checks, configuration lookup, secret decryption, retries and the delivery log are the channel's and the dispatcher's.
